correctness.rationale: Every nontrivial binary cut on K_{m,n} is classified using k,ell occupancies and explicit radius-0,1,2 averages. The mutually exclusive high-radius-one cases yield upper bounds by respective one-spike ratios; one-sided signed data reduce to a scalar strict chord inequality, which also yields quantitative rigidity. value.rationale: Characteristic graph cuts are a canonical BV test family. The theorem computes their exact sharp gain on all complete bipartite graphs and separately solves every real signal supported on one color class, with concentration rigidity and a sharp phase boundary. It detects noncontraction on dense diameter-two graphs and the unattained asymptotic cut factor two. No full-input BV theorem is claimed.
